description: SE3D sequence splits and frame lists. Each frame is [timestamp, frame]: the timestamp is CARLA simulation time in nanoseconds (the i-th line of timestamps.txt) and frame is the file number of the label, image and disparity files. "test" is the benchmark test set (every second frame of the test sequences, starting at the third). "test_car_filtered" is the earlier test list that kept only frames with a Car and is provided for comparison with the original submission. Train and validation keep only frames with at least one Car.
